```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- readRDS("data/imdb_snapshots.rds") |> as_tibble()

imdb_snapshots

imdb_snapshots |>
  count(snap_year)
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(snap_year, title, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015)

rank_changes |>
  slice_max(abs(rank_change), n = 10)
```
